Generated by the Snowball compiler v3.1.1 (https://snowballstem.org/), the same release as the
Python `snowballstemmer` 3.1.1 the engine uses, so the server stems exactly like the app:

    ./snowball algorithms/russian.sbl -js -o russian-stemmer
    ./snowball algorithms/english.sbl -js -o english-stemmer
    cp javascript/base-stemmer.js .
